title: Sensitive text gate
instruction: Check whether this text is safe to paste into a cloud assistant: clean, personal data about a real-looking person, or a secret or credential.

labels.name: Clean
labels.definition: Ordinary work text with no personal details about a person and no secrets, even if it contains names of products or companies, ticket or order numbers, versions, dates, prices or example.com placeholders.

labels.name: Personal data
labels.definition: Real-looking personal details about an individual, such as names with birth dates, home addresses, personal phone numbers or emails, health or financial account details.

labels.name: Secret or credential
labels.definition: API keys, access tokens, passwords, private keys, connection strings with passwords or other values that grant access.

business_rules: Fail closed: the text is sent to the cloud assistant only when the model says clean with high confidence; anything else (personal-data, secret-or-credential, or low confidence) is blocked and the user is told why.
This is a speed bump to catch accidents, not a compliance control, and it must never be described as one.
